_doc: The shared material library. Every material in every asset is one of these roles,
exported under the role's name. Colours are sRGB hex, as a colour picker shows them;
the build converts them to linear for glTF.
An asset may override a role's colour in its asset.json palette, and nothing else.
Roles with "palette": true must be named in the palette of any asset that uses them,
because the defaults are neutral greys and the brief is meant to choose the colour.
For emissive, "color" is the emitted colour; the surface colour is derived from it
(base_from_emission x colour, linear), and the strength is exported as

paint_primary.doc: Main painted body: the asset's identity colour, usually the lightest mass.

paint_secondary.doc: Second paint, for value contrast against paint_primary.

metal_dark.doc: Dark machined or anodised metal: frames, joints, rails.

metal_bare.doc: Bright bare metal: wear surfaces, barrels, small fittings.

rubber.doc: Soft black rubber: pads, seals, tyres, cable sheaths.

glass.doc: Clear glass or visor: alpha-blended, smooth.

emissive.doc: Lights that mean something: indicators, sensors and eyes, weak spots, interactables.

emissive_secondary.doc: Quieter lights worked into the design: power lights, status strips, thruster glow. Dimmer than emissive, often another colour.

emissive_core.doc: A weak spot's exposed core: only for weak spots, so players learn what it means. The game pulses it.
